About the NorthStar Cycling Sunday Service group ride

A Sunday no-drop ride organized by and for Black, Brown and Indigenous riders in Seattle. Easy pace, rolls from the club's Central District clubhouse. The club's stated aim is to take down barriers to cycling and support riders' physical and mental health. All bikes welcome.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
